operations.name: addmodulescore
operations.title: Add module score
operations.description: Seurat-style module scoring using matched control features by expression bin.

parameters.name: features
parameters.help: Module feature IDs: character vector or list of vectors.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.help: Optional control feature pool; defaults to all matrix features.

parameters.name: nbin
parameters.help: Number of expression bins for control matching.

parameters.name: ctrl
parameters.help: Control features sampled per module feature.

parameters.name: name
parameters.help: Prefix for module names when features are unnamed.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.help: Random seed for control sampling.

outputs.name: module_scores
outputs.description: Per-cell module scores for one or more signatures.

operations.name: ucell
operations.title: UCell Signature Scoring
operations.description: Rank-based per-cell signature scoring using pack-owned chunking over canonical typed slices.

parameters.name: features
parameters.help: Signature feature IDs: character vector or list of vectors.

parameters.name: name
parameters.help: Prefix for signature names when features are unnamed.

parameters.name: max_rank
parameters.help: Maximum rank considered by UCell.

parameters.name: ncores
parameters.help: Number of worker processes requested by UCell.

parameters.name: parallel_backend
parameters.help: Execution backend for UCell. Use 'serial' to avoid socket-based parallel backends on constrained systems.

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.help: Cell-axis chunk size for engine-owned UCell execution. Use NULL to disable chunking.

parameters.name: missing_features_policy
parameters.help: How to handle signature features missing from the matrix.

outputs.name: signature_scores
outputs.description: Per-cell UCell scores for one or more signatures.

outputs.name: signature_summary
outputs.description: Per-signature scoring summary and feature-match diagnostics.

operations.name: cell_vector_family_reduce
operations.title: Reduce Cell Vector Family
operations.description: Reduce a keyed signal family to labels and deterministic diagnostics.

parameters.name: signal_keys
parameters.help: Optional signal-key subset within the cell_vector_family.

parameters.name: rule
parameters.help: Reduction rule used to choose one label per cell.

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.help: Optional minimum winning score required to emit a non-unknown label.

parameters.name: min_margin
parameters.help: Optional minimum top-vs-second margin required to emit a non-unknown label.

parameters.name: unknown_label
parameters.help: Fallback label emitted when thresholds or ties abstain.

parameters.name: ties
parameters.help: How to handle tied top scores.

parameters.name: tie_tol
parameters.help: Tolerance used when detecting ties.

outputs.name: label
outputs.description: Per-cell categorical labels after reducing the signal family.

outputs.name: top_score
outputs.description: Winning score for each cell.

outputs.name: runner_up_score
outputs.description: Second-best score for each cell.

outputs.name: score_margin
outputs.description: Winning minus runner-up score for each cell.

outputs.name: abstain_reason
outputs.description: Per-cell abstention reason (`none`, `tie`, `min_score`, `min_margin`).

outputs.name: decision_table
outputs.description: Per-cell reduction diagnostics including label, scores, margin, and abstention reason.

outputs.name: label_summary
outputs.description: Per-label counts and score summaries after reduction.

operations.name: cell_vector_family_calibrate
operations.title: Calibrate Cell Vector Family
operations.description: Calibrate each selected signal key independently.

parameters.name: signal_keys
parameters.help: Optional signal-key subset within the cell_vector_family.

parameters.name: method
parameters.help: Calibration method applied independently within each key.

parameters.name: center
parameters.help: For z-score calibration, subtract the fitted center.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.help: For z-score calibration, divide by the fitted scale.

parameters.name: ties_method
parameters.help: Rank tie handling for percentile calibration.

parameters.name: na_rm
parameters.help: Ignore non-finite values when fitting calibration.

outputs.name: calibrated_signal
outputs.description: Calibrated per-cell values for each key in the signal family.

outputs.name: calibration_summary
outputs.description: Per-key calibration statistics for raw and calibrated values.

operations.name: cell_vector_family_qc
operations.title: QC Cell Vector Family
operations.description: Compute per-key, pairwise, and optional grouped diagnostics.

parameters.name: signal_keys
parameters.help: Optional signal-key subset within the cell_vector_family.

parameters.name: correlation_methods
parameters.help: Pairwise correlation methods to compute between keys.

parameters.name: tie_tol
parameters.help: Tolerance used when counting tied top-key winners.

outputs.name: key_summary
outputs.description: Per-key QC summaries including score distribution, finite coverage, and winner frequencies.

outputs.name: pairwise_summary
outputs.description: Pairwise key relationships including overlap counts and correlations.

outputs.name: group_summary
outputs.description: Per-group per-key QC summaries when an optional grouping vector is supplied.

operations.name: cell_vector_family_graph_smooth
operations.title: Graph Smooth Cell Vector Family
operations.description: Smooth signal keys over nearest-neighbor geometry with authenticated source ancestry.

parameters.name: signal_keys
parameters.help: Optional key subset within the cell_vector_family.

parameters.name: dims
parameters.help: Optional dimensions of the selected space. NULL uses all dimensions.

parameters.name: k
parameters.help: Nearest-neighbor count per cell.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.help: Blend weight for raw score in alpha * raw + (1 - alpha) * neighbor_mean.

parameters.name: distance_metric
parameters.help: Distance metric used for nearest-neighbor search.

parameters.name: query_chunk_size
parameters.help: Number of query cells processed per nearest-neighbor chunk.

parameters.name: include_self
parameters.help: Include each cell itself in its neighbor mean.

parameters.name: na_policy
parameters.help: How missing signal values are handled during neighbor averaging.

parameters.name: source_signal_artifact_id
parameters.help: Optional source cell_vector_family artifact ID copied into metadata.

parameters.name: source_run_id
parameters.help: Optional source run ID copied into metadata.

parameters.name: source_snapshot_id
parameters.help: Optional source provenance snapshot ID copied into metadata.

outputs.name: smoothed_signal
outputs.description: Geometry-smoothed per-cell values for each selected key.

outputs.name: smoothing_summary
outputs.description: Per-key smoothing diagnostics and parameter echo.

operations.name: cell_vector_winners
operations.title: Cell Vector Winner Assignment
operations.description: Assign deterministic winners and pruning diagnostics from a signal family.

parameters.name: signal_keys
parameters.help: Optional key subset within the cell_vector_family.

parameters.name: min_winners
parameters.help: Minimum raw winner count required for a winner label to pass pruning.

parameters.name: tie_method
parameters.help: Deterministic tie handling for top-score winners.

parameters.name: source_score_artifact_id
parameters.help: Optional source cell_vector_family artifact ID copied into winner table metadata.

parameters.name: source_run_id
parameters.help: Optional source run ID copied into winner table metadata.

parameters.name: source_snapshot_id
parameters.help: Optional source provenance snapshot ID copied into winner table metadata.

outputs.name: winners
outputs.description: Per-cell winner, runner-up, confidence, and pruning table.

operations.name: winner_cell_sets
operations.title: Winner Cell-Set Registration
operations.description: Request atomic core-owned admission of the complete winner-derived cell-set family.

parameters.name: source_winner_artifact_id
parameters.help: Optional source winner obs_table artifact ID copied into manifest metadata.

parameters.name: cell_set_prefix
parameters.help: Prefix used after set: when creating winner cell-set names.

parameters.name: winner_col
parameters.help: Winner-label column in the winner table.

parameters.name: passes_col
parameters.help: Logical pruning-pass column in the winner table.

parameters.name: source
parameters.help: Source label stored on cell-set membership rows.

parameters.name: created_by
parameters.help: Optional actor stored on cell-set membership rows.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.help: If TRUE, replace existing winner cell-set memberships.

outputs.name: manifest
outputs.description: One row per registered winner cell set.

outputs.name: cell_set_family
outputs.description: Atomic core-owned admission request for the complete winner-derived cell-set family.

operations.name: feature_set_overlap_qc
operations.title: Feature-Set Matrix Overlap QC
operations.description: Screen authenticated feature-set-registry entries against a matrix universe.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.help: Single feature-set namespace to QC.

parameters.name: namespaces
parameters.help: Optional multiple feature-set namespaces to QC.

parameters.name: feature_sets
parameters.help: Optional feature-set subset within selected namespaces.

parameters.name: min_set_size
parameters.help: Minimum mapped/detected genes required to include a set.

parameters.name: max_set_size
parameters.help: Maximum mapped/detected genes allowed to include a set.

parameters.name: min_detected_fraction
parameters.help: Minimum fraction of source genes detected in the matrix.

parameters.name: deduplicate_sets
parameters.help: If TRUE, duplicate mapped-gene signatures after the first are excluded.

outputs.name: overlap_qc
outputs.description: One row per feature set with raw, mapped, detected counts and include/exclude status.

outputs.name: namespace_summary
outputs.description: Namespace-level count and overlap summaries.

operations.name: pathway_enrich
operations.title: Pathway Enrichment
operations.description: Hypergeometric enrichment against an authenticated feature-set namespace snapshot.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.help: Feature-set namespace from wb_feature_sets() (e.g. bcell_gsea).

parameters.name: feature_col
parameters.help: Column in input feature table containing feature IDs (usually feature_id).

parameters.name: p_adj_col
parameters.help: Adjusted p-value column used for query filtering.

parameters.name: p_adj_max
parameters.help: Maximum adjusted p-value for query features.

parameters.name: lfc_col
parameters.help: Effect-size column used for directional filtering.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.help: Directional filter: any|up|down.

parameters.name: lfc_min_abs
parameters.help: Minimum |effect| when direction='any'.

parameters.name: lfc_min
parameters.help: Minimum effect for direction='up'/'down'.

parameters.name: min_set_size
parameters.help: Minimum pathway size to test.

parameters.name: max_set_size
parameters.help: Maximum pathway size to test.

parameters.name: p_adjust_method
parameters.help: Method passed to p.adjust.

outputs.name: pathways
outputs.description: Pathway enrichment statistics for one namespace.
